summary: Frontend testing completed for PDF export functionality and guest user read-only access. All features working correctly: Export dropdown shows 'Ficha del Indicador' and 'Reporte Detallado (PDF)' options, PDF generation works without console errors, guest user has read-only access with action buttons visible but disabled.
critical_code_review_comments: Export dropdown correctly implemented with data-testid attributes (btn-exportar, btn-export-ficha, btn-export-pdf)
PDF generation using html2pdf.js works without console errors
Read-only mode correctly implemented with disabledBtnStyle = { opacity: 0.5, cursor: 'not-allowed' }
Guest user correctly restricted to OPERACIONES menu only (no SEGURIDAD, PARAMETRICAS, or Configuración)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All PDF export features and guest read-only access verified. Export dropdown has 3 options: Ficha del Indicador, Reporte Detallado (PDF), and Exportar a CSV. The PROGRAMADO row is visible in the monthly tracking table. Guest user sees limited sidebar menu.

feature_1_admin_login.details: Admin login with admin/P1c0l0c0 successful. Dashboard shows 'ADMINISTRADOR SMS' role and 'Vista Administrador'.

feature_2_seguimiento_navigation.details: Navigation to OPERACIONES -> Seguimiento works correctly. View loads with indicator selection, monthly tracking table, and export options.

feature_3_export_dropdown.details: Export dropdown (📥 Exportar ▾) shows all 3 options: '📋 Ficha del Indicador', '📄 Reporte Detallado (PDF)', '📊 Exportar a CSV'. All options have correct data-testid attributes.

feature_4_pdf_generation.details: PDF 'Ficha del Indicador' generation triggered successfully. No console errors during PDF generation. html2pdf.js works correctly.

feature_5_guest_login.details: Guest login with invitado/invitado123 successful. Dashboard shows 'USUARIO INVITADO' role and 'Vista Usuario'. Sidebar shows only OPERACIONES menu.

feature_6_guest_readonly_buttons.details: All action buttons VISIBLE but DISABLED for guest user: Guardar (opacity=0.5, cursor=not-allowed), + Agregar archivo (opacity=0.5, cursor=not-allowed). Input fields and textareas also disabled (opacity=0.5). Exportar button remains ENABLED for read-only users.
